PublicContent.Introduction: CareNova connects you with pharmacy services and healthcare professionals. Explore our medicines, discover doctors and register to access patient services.

Services.Title: Pharmacy services
Services.Description: Browse medicines, check availability and learn about prescription requirements.

Services.Title: Healthcare professionals
Services.Description: Find doctors and explore their published professional information.

Services.Title: Patient services
